files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
**This release introduces two default behavior changes, make sure to read below**

### Added

- Support for Nextcloud 34

### Changed

- Confirm account deletion by default. An e-mail containing a confirmation link is sent to the user before the account can be deleted.
- Purge account data by default after one week. Users are simply disabled in the meantime.
- Move to Vue 3 and Typescript
- Dependencies updates

### Removed

- Support for Nextcloud 31
